title: Church of Santa Prisca de Taxco
scope: The standing Santa Prisca and San Sebastián church in Taxco, its paired belfries, carved facade, tiled dome, attached chapel and parish rooms.
limitations: The exterior uses simplified stone figures, relief and tile motifs. The clock and roof colors reflect the documented material family.
Historic photographs and mapped outlines define the permanent church exterior and attached blocks. The interiors, movable items and surrounding blocks are omitted.
